Package com.example.ecolums

Class CalculationMetric

java.lang.Object
com.example.ecolums.CalculationMetric
public class CalculationMetric extends Object
Represents a single CO2 conversion factor or impact-calculation metric managed by the Campus Sustainability Office.

Stored in the Firestore collection calculationMetrics. Admins update these via AdminDashboard; ActivityLog reads them when converting raw inputs into CO2 equivalents.

Example: metricKey = "BIKE_PER_KM", value = 0.21, unit = "kg CO2/km".

Outstanding issues: Unit normalisation (imperial vs metric) not yet handled.
